title: Buat prompt generator Seedance di ChatGPT yang menerima gambar referensi +…
content: Buat prompt generator Seedance di ChatGPT yang menerima gambar referensi + deskripsi animasi, lalu mengeluarkan prompt animasi siap pakai untuk workflow text-to-video, image-to-video, dan storyboard.
tips: Buat prompt generator Seedance di ChatGPT yang menerima gambar referensi + deskripsi animasi, lalu mengeluarkan prompt animasi siap pakai untuk workflow text-to-video, image-to-video, dan storyboard.

en.content:
Create a Seedance prompt generator in ChatGPT that accepts a reference image + animation description, then outputs a ready-to-use animation prompt for text-to-video, image-to-video, and storyboard workflows.

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
I made a prompt generator for Seedance in ChatGPT.

So you can create Text-to-Video, Image-to-Video, and storyboard animations without the hassle.

Just send your reference image and your animation request, and this generator will produce an animation prompt ready for you to use.

Would anyone be interested?
---
